name: Dr. Gesa Biermann
headline: Chief of Staff, CEO Office @RobCo | Co-Founder @Pina Earth (Y Combinator W22) | CDTM | UC Berkeley | PhD @LMU
summary: My interests lie, where technology and sustainability meet. As a co-founder of the climate-tech startup Pina Earth, I work on a solution to protect our forests by quantifying and rewarding sustainable forestry. Previously, I taught innovation and entrepreneurship methods as part of the Management Team of the Center for Digital Technology and Management (CDTM), a joint institution of LMU and TUM in Munich. I completed my PhD at LMU, where I researched sustainable food consumption. I have experience in environmental impact assessment (LCA) and published articles on the sustainability of our food system in the peer-reviewed journals Nature Sustainability, Current Research in Environmental Sustainability, Appetite, and Aquaculture.I'm looking forward to fruitful discussions and inspiration on what living within the bounds of our planet could look like.

positions.title: Co-Founder & CEO (YC W22)
positions.description:
Europe’s Leading Tech-Enabled Forest Carbon Platform

Pina Earth protects our forests by quantifying and rewarding sustainable forestry. With our suite of digital tools for data collection, monitoring, and certification, forest owners can start high-quality carbon projects on their properties. Buyers of the resulting carbon credits invest in preparing local forests for a changing climate. 

Pina Earth is backed by Y Combinator (W22) and further leading VCs and business angels: https://techcrunch.com/2022/07/05/pina-earth-seed/ 

In 2025, Pina Earth and Tree.ly merged to scale our impact even further.

company.name: RobCo
company.tagline: RobCo’s vision is to automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary
company.description:
RobCo's mission is to automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraodinary. 

Founded in 2020 out of the Technical University of Munich, RobCo is on a mission to make industrial automation more accessible, affordable, and adaptable. Its patented modular hardware kit, combined with the RobCo Studio no-code software platform, allows industrial companies of all sizes to automate repetitive and dangerous tasks quickly and with unmatched flexibility. Whether it’s machine tending, palletizing, dispensing, or welding, RobCo’s modular robot kits provide versatile end-to-end solutions that are simple to deploy and manage remotely — without heavy upfront investment or specialist expertise. With offices in Munich and San Francisco and robots already in operation worldwide, RobCo is supercharging a new generation of industrial companies to reduce costs, boost productivity, and compete on a global stage.
